The '''Ultrawave Transmitter''' was a device created by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Nasan Godera]] at some point by the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. This machine was later abandoned on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] where it remained undiscovered for [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. The machine worked by sending out a signal that was capable of influencing the native [[rakghoul]] populations. It was for this reason that the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Ki Sazen]] traveled to Taris with her [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] followers where she intended to claim the transmitter and turn the rakghouls into her own personal army.

As a result, the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] under [[Ardun Kothe]] dispatched [[Agent/Legends|agents]] that included [[Cipher Nine]] and [[Chance (SIS)|Chance]] to the planet in order to prevent Sazen from achieving her objective. As Kothe revealed later, the Ultrawave Transmitter contained the activation codes for the [[Shadow Arsenal]] on [[Quesh]], another one of Godera's inventions.
